proposals.evidence: DEDR 3582 gives Toda naṛ- “walk” and the Kodagu paradigm naḍa- (naḍap-, naḍand-) “walk”, with Tamil naṭa past -nt-. These support the survey’s naḍand- sequence in this family; retain final -ə without asserting that the Toda record has the same exact inflectional category as the comparative paradigms.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 5496(a) gives Toda pöł̣ “white” and pöł̣f- (pöł̣t-) “be white”, corroborated by the later dictionary. The survey’s unrounded e, plain l and final i remain transcription/inflection qualifications; the t-bearing form is supported by the verbal paradigm within the whole article.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 3504 and 4616 both attest Toda toz-mox “Toda woman”; the later dictionary explicitly cites both families for the complete compound “Toda woman, wife, female”. Propose the Toda designation plus mox “child, woman” as ordered components, retaining the survey’s tus-, long ō, g and final -ə rather than claiming exact phonetic identity.
